summary: scripts/st-test waits for a pool tree in the build host's order (cargo-priority rank by ST_AGENT, aged as the cargo shim ages it, then arrival) instead of a race to the next free tree, and sets ADMISSION_RUN=st-test-<pid>@<start-ns> for each run's checks so the host's finish-first admission can serve a run's later stages by the run's start

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: No evidence rule changes; the variable only names the run to the build host's admission queue.

compatibility.detail: An older st-test still polls for trees and can take one ahead of the queue until it is updated. A host without finish-first admission, or with FINISH_FIRST 0, ignores ADMISSION_RUN (its cargo shim only logs it).

recovery.detail: Revert the change to scripts/st-test; the queue/ directory under the pool can stay or be removed. FINISH_FIRST 0 in the host's admission config turns off the finish-first use of ADMISSION_RUN.
